exposure: FSH-resistant ovaries (FSHRO) due to an inactivating A189V FSH receptor mutation
cohort: 26 women with primary ovarian insufficiency (POI) due to FSH-resistant ovaries.
finding: Women with FSHRO initiated hormone therapy later and used it for a shorter period compared to the normal fertile period, and while they did not have increased CVD or MetS risk factors, osteopenia was common despite HT.
